items.title: Showing what you mean in the age of AI
items.summary: With the new Loom for Mac, Record for agent, and MCP tools, teams can now hand off work to AI agents the same way they do to teammates: by showing the work, with every detail captured. Explaining an idea clearly enough for someone else to act on used to be one of the slowest parts […]The post Showing what you mean in the age of AI appeared first on Inside Atlassian.
